entries.5d0b37513278fdd4: This is a reportable segment handled by the company. It sells colored steel sheets, solar power roofing, ALC fitting auxiliary materials and ceramic-based building material fitting auxiliary materials mainly to construction contractors such as roofing and exterior sheet-metal contractors, and also sells architectural hardware, welded wire mesh and steel wire to wholesalers and manufacturers. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥4,469 million.
entries.7a059a2c78db341b: This is a reportable segment handled by consolidated subsidiary Aishin Co., Ltd. It sells exterior products, such as carports, storage sheds, fences and stone materials, to housebuilders and exterior construction contractors. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥12,895 million. Effective October 1, 2025, Aishin Co., Ltd. absorbed Aiesu Line Co., Ltd. through a merger and consolidated the business that Aiesu Line Co., Ltd. had handled, including the transport of exterior products.
entries.edab55d74689aa4b: A specialized construction materials trading company headquartered in Nagoya that sells interior building materials, exterior products and living environment-related products.
entries.fec2054d2ef1b6db: This is a reportable segment handled by the company. The company sells interior construction materials, such as lightweight steel base materials and gypsum board, mainly to interior finishing contractors that carry out ceiling finishing and partition work. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥18,078 million, the largest of the segments.
